description: Get the current lifecycle state of a session, including available transitions, state history, and SC resolution. Returns current_state, available_transitions, verification_deadline (when state=delivered), timestamps, duration, sc_resolution (the fundamental SC event: resolved, resolved_at, resolved_by, billing_model), and recent transition history with from/to/at/by/method fields. Requires X-Org-Api-Key. Shape per docs/protocol/sc-event-canonical-schema-2026-04-18.md §7.1.
name: lifecycle_get_state
